findings.title: Backup codes can be used more than once under concurrent login requests
findings.body: This read-modify-write is not atomic: two simultaneous login requests can both read the same encrypted list, find the same code, and then each successfully update the user's credentials and complete authentication. That lets a supposedly single-use backup code grant multiple sessions. Consume the code with an atomic conditional update (or equivalent transaction/locking) and reject a request if another request has already consumed it.
